# Noetfield Systems Inc.
> AI workflows, RWA readiness and real-to-onchain engineering with explicit authority, verifiable controls and evidence boundaries.

## Primary
- [RWA & Onchain Infrastructure](https://www.noetfield.com/onchain/): Client-facing engineering, demonstrations, delivery model and project intake
- [Ecosystem and Founding Registry](https://www.noetfield.com/onchain/#community): Segmented community and protocol-interest intake, not token allocation
- [Noetfield Onchain Wallet Community Hub](https://www.noetfield.com/onchain/hub/): EVM signed identity, PostgreSQL XP, daily verified check-ins, qualified referrals and token interest registry; NFIELD not issued
- [Onchain Ecosystem Research Paper](https://www.noetfield.com/onchain/whitepaper/): Architecture, use cases, phased roadmap and token research status
- [Machine-readable Ecosystem Program Status](https://www.noetfield.com/onchain/ecosystem.json): Status of token, airdrop, stablecoin research and network exploration
- [Onchain Capability Manifest](https://www.noetfield.com/onchain/capabilities.json): Machine-readable offerings, evidence, limitations, owners and contact method
- [Home](https://www.noetfield.com/): Company home
- [Developers](https://www.noetfield.com/developers/): What engineers can use today
- [System](https://www.noetfield.com/system/): How the pieces fit
- [AI Motors](https://www.noetfield.com/motors/): How a run is allowed
- [Tools](https://www.noetfield.com/tools/): Operator cost checks (no signup)
- [Runways](https://www.noetfield.com/runways/): Qualification paths to accepted output
- [Deterministic API](https://www.noetfield.com/deterministic-api/): OpenAI-shaped schema-valid API preview
- [Proof](https://www.noetfield.com/proof/): Evidence before claims
- [Applications](https://www.noetfield.com/applications/): What ships as product
- [Contact](https://www.noetfield.com/contact/?topic=pilot-client): Talk to Noetfield

## First-party RWA & agent evidence
- [RWA Readiness Clinic](https://scan.noetfield.com/rwa-clinic/): Live technical assessment using first-party examples, not regulatory approval
- [Agent Control Plane](https://control.noetfield.com/sandbox): Live synthetic authorization demo; no funds moved
- [Company OS](https://www.noetfield.com/company-os/): Scoped operating model and component maturity
- [Studio](https://studio.noetfield.com/): Public examples of custom engineering
